original_source: Error responses across multiple Cloud products
failure_pattern: A feature flag update introduced an incorrect policy value in the infrastructure API gateway, and a bug in the gateway code caused it to reject all traffic, leading to 5XX errors and a full outage across all products.
mitigation_principle: Prevent high-risk feature flags from production use; enforce longer soak time for policy changes; require progressive rollouts for feature flags; review defaults of infrastructure feature flags; improve testing of policy changes; enhance communication tooling

symptoms: errors using the powerup on boards
failure_pattern: The Jira powerup integration failed to communicate with Jira’s API during installation and usage, causing errors for users attempting to add or use the powerup on Trello boards.
mitigation_principle: 1. Implement comprehensive error handling for third‑party API calls; 2. Add health‑check endpoints and monitoring for integration services; 3. Use circuit breakers and exponential back‑off retries; 4. Provide clear user feedback and fallback options; 5. Conduct regular integration regression testing.

original_source: Some users may experience delays in receiving email notifications
symptoms: email deliverability issues for specific recipient domains
failure_pattern: Between 12:00am 9th July and 08:00am 10th July, the email notification service experienced deliverability issues for certain recipient domains across multiple Atlassian products. The issue was caused by a failure in the third‑party email provider's API, leading to delayed or failed email deliveries. The problem was resolved once the provider restored service, after which emails flowed normally.
mitigation_principle: Implement comprehensive monitoring and alerting for email delivery metrics; add fallback email relay and circuit breaker; perform regular health checks and automated tests on third‑party email services; maintain redundancy and failover configurations; document incident response procedures and automate rollback

original_source: Email to Board feature isn't working as expected for some customers
symptoms: Email-to-Board feature failing for some users
feature not working correctly for some customers
failure_pattern: A temporary outage in the email-to-board feature was caused by a misconfiguration in the email ingestion service, leading to incomplete processing of incoming emails for some users. The issue was identified through monitoring and resolved by correcting the configuration.
mitigation_principle: Implement automated health checks for email ingestion service; add circuit breaker to prevent cascading failures; enforce configuration validation and automated rollback; improve monitoring and alerting for email processing metrics; test configuration changes in staging before production.

original_source: Users are experiencing reCaptcha errors while signing up
failure_pattern: The reCaptcha verification service returned errors, causing signup attempts to fail.
mitigation_principle: Implement retry logic for third-party API calls; add circuit breaker to prevent cascading failures; monitor third-party API health and latency; add fallback or graceful degradation for signup flow; set up alerting for reCaptcha errors; validate configuration changes before deployment.

original_source: Boards are demonstrating slow performance for Workspace Guests
failure_pattern: A performance regression caused slow loading of boards and cards for Workspace Guests, especially on large boards, leading to noticeable latency. The issue was identified and a fix was deployed, restoring normal performance.
mitigation_principle: Implement automated performance regression tests; monitor latency metrics for guest users; enforce code review for changes affecting board rendering; set up alerts for abnormal load times

original_source: Users aren't able to create new repeats or run existing ones when using the Card Repeater Power-Up
failure_pattern: A recent change to the Card Repeater Power-Up introduced a bug that prevented users from creating new repeats or executing existing ones, causing repeat functionality to fail across Trello.com and the API until a fix was deployed.
mitigation_principle: Implement automated regression tests for power-up features; perform code reviews with focus on repeat logic; add monitoring for repeat creation and execution; deploy feature flags to roll out changes gradually

original_source: The Trello Desktop app is re-directing users to the home page
failure_pattern: A bug in the Trello Desktop app's navigation logic caused users to be redirected to the home page instead of the intended destination.
mitigation_principle: 1. Implement comprehensive UI regression tests; 2. Use feature flags for navigation changes; 3. Conduct thorough code reviews; 4. Monitor redirect metrics; 5. Deploy incremental releases

failure_pattern: A misconfiguration in the realtime update service caused degraded performance, leading to slow updates for some customers until a fix was applied.
mitigation_principle: Implement automated health checks; enforce configuration validation; monitor latency metrics; use canary deployments for changes; maintain rollback procedures.

failure_pattern: A recent infrastructure change caused network instability, leading to dropped connections and slow updates for Trello users.
mitigation_principle: Implement automated rollback on infrastructure changes; monitor connection metrics; use canary deployments; add circuit breakers; perform post-deployment health checks

symptoms: errors when loading boards and cards
failure_pattern: Rollback to a previous release triggered a scaling-down process, leaving insufficient compute nodes to handle traffic, causing service slowdown and errors until automated scaling restored capacity.
mitigation_principle: Implement pre-scaling during rollbacks; improve rollback tooling UX; conduct incident response training focused on rollback best practices; enforce capacity checks before rollback; automate scaling safeguards

original_source: Trello is slow or unavailable for some users
symptoms: slow or unavailable for some users
unable to view boards or cards
failure_pattern: An infrastructure tool applied a default OS DNS configuration to a database node after a metadata fetch error, causing internal domain resolution failures that prevented session expiration and led to session exhaustion on that shard, which in turn caused Trello operations to fail and the service to become slow or unavailable.
mitigation_principle: Implement safe fallback DNS configuration in infrastructure tooling; add monitoring for internal DNS resolution; monitor database session counts on all nodes; streamline incident response procedures.

symptoms: errors when viewing cards and boards
service disruption for all Trello customers
failure_pattern: A cached query plan expired, causing many replanning operations that consumed CPU, leading to prolonged planning times and a feedback loop that degraded performance, resulting in slow loading and errors for all Trello customers.
mitigation_principle: Increase cache size or refresh strategy to prevent plan expiration under load; add query planner hints for known problematic queries; monitor CPU usage during replanning; add capacity overhead for shards; implement automated throttling or fallback to simpler plans; reduce single points of failure for board loading

original_source: Issues affecting user syncing, Atlassian Administration
symptoms: errors loading Users and Groups pages
user syncing failures across Confluence, Jira, Trello, Guard
failure_pattern: A misconfiguration in the user IDP sync process caused errors loading Users and Groups pages across multiple Atlassian services, leading to user syncing failures. The issue was identified and resolved by correcting the configuration, restoring normal operation.
mitigation_principle: Implement automated configuration validation; add monitoring for user sync errors; enforce change management with rollback procedures; conduct post‑incident reviews; add redundancy for IDP sync

original_source: The search bar functionality in Trello is not working properly
failure_pattern: A misconfiguration in the search service prevented the frontend from receiving search results, causing the search bar to be unresponsive for users.
mitigation_principle: Implement automated configuration validation; add health checks and circuit breakers for search service; monitor search metrics and set alerts; enforce rollback procedures on deployment failures

original_source: Degraded experience adding and accessing media attachments
symptoms: degraded user experience when adding media attachments
failure_pattern: A misconfiguration in the media attachment service caused increased latency, leading to slow uploads and retrievals, which degraded the user experience.
mitigation_principle: Implement automated configuration validation; Monitor media attachment latency thresholds; Set up alerting for abnormal upload/download times; Conduct regular reviews of third-party storage integration.

original_source: Users experiencing issues with Email to Board failing
symptoms: error message 'This message could not be delivered due to a recipient error. Please try again later.'
cards not created in Trello via email
failure_pattern: A faulty internal configuration caused the Email to Board service to reject messages, leading to delivery errors and preventing card creation via email.
mitigation_principle: Implement configuration validation and automated tests for configuration changes; use feature flags to roll out configuration changes gradually; monitor email delivery errors and alert on anomalies; maintain a rollback plan for configuration changes

symptoms: support portal displaying temporary channel message
failure_pattern: An outage at AWS disrupted the underlying infrastructure that powers Atlassian Cloud services, causing widespread service unavailability and impacting the support portal. Atlassian teams monitored the situation, communicated updates, and worked with AWS to restore services.
mitigation_principle: 1. Deploy multi-cloud or hybrid redundancy; 2. Implement real-time monitoring of third-party provider status; 3. Define clear incident response and communication protocols; 4. Maintain fallback services; 5. Conduct regular dependency risk assessments
